purpose: Feasibility of a blinded debugging-value study; novelty is a separate review, not inferred from speed.

case.revealAfter: Data collection and blinded outcome scoring are locked
case.hardwareRequirement: Physical Apple M3/Metal observer mandatory; AMD Vulkan is a portability control and does not expose this defect
case.runtimeReplay: Frozen 6f94e8fe current runtime with original 161e0e12 defective shader and honestly regenerated pins; no historical whole-release or signed-Capsule claim.

design.initialStudy: Two fresh AI contexts, one per workflow, descriptive feasibility pilot only
design.assignment: Run order randomized before investigator start: standard, inspection
design.confirmatoryStudy: Separate preregistration with multiple bugs and investigators randomized across workflows
design.runtimePins: Freeze exact installed runtime, toolchain, driver and hardware identities before starting; checkout availability is distinct from published package availability

participants.appleHardwareOperator: Each investigator through audited offline wrapper; coordinator verifies outcomes
participants.outcomeAssessor: Fresh packet auditor later given anonymized patches for reproduction; informed coordinator assesses known mechanism
participants.excluded: E and all previously exposed contexts are excluded as investigators. Owner explicitly authorized fresh workspace AI agents on 2026-11-07.
participants.modelVersion: Inherited agent model, identifier not exposed by agent tool; training contamination unknown.

blinding.causeBlinded: Cause withheld from fresh contexts; absence of pretraining exposure cannot be established
blinding.networkAccess: DENIED for both investigator environments; preload identical allowed tools, references and documentation
blinding.history: No Git history/remotes, answer reports or fixed shader in either packet. Current source is declared diagnostic replay.
blinding.modelContamination: Owner-authorized fresh AI contexts supersede original draft ban on API-backed agents. AI inference is external to command sandbox. Training exposure unknown; no human-blinded or definitive comparative claim.
blinding.audit: Fresh audit found no confirmed case answer leak; unrelated historical narrative directories removed before investigator starts. All observations from setup/audit archived outside packets.
blinding.enforcementBoundary: Wrapped subprocesses only; direct tools remain technically available and are prohibited by investigator instructions. Compliance must be assessed separately.

shared: Identical physical Apple M3. AMD control after trials by assessor, not investigator access.
Identical failing program, model artifacts, input bytes, reference outputs and correctness tolerances
Ordinary debugger, logs, logprobs, parity checks, GPU profiler and offline reference implementation
Identical network restrictions, documentation access, setup completion and time budget
workflows.baseline: Competent standard debugging workflow; reasonable custom glue permitted and counted
workflows.doppler: Same baseline plus version-pinned documented Doppler inspection, exact-prefix replay, fingerprints and semantic-boundary evidence that actually work with this case
workflows.capabilityAudit: Before freeze, name installed entry points and verify the case can use them. Unavailable facilities remain unavailable; proposed instrumentation cannot be scored as an existing feature.

milestones.isolation: Identify the first faulty boundary and support the actual mechanism; record each timestamp separately
milestones.minimalReproduction: Smallest practical submitted case independent of unrelated application state, rerunnable by another person
milestones.verifiedFix: Independent correctness oracle passes plus original application symptom and Apple/AMD controls; do not require the authors exact patch. Record reversion/workaround versus mechanism repair and any tradeoffs.

metrics.primary: Elapsed seconds from equal-ready start to independently verified fix; correctness required
secondary: Elapsed seconds to detection, first faulty boundary, supported cause and minimal reproduction
Active investigator seconds, separately from setup and machine waits
New custom code lines and files, including generated code; also record changed/deleted lines
Manual interventions by count and type, tool calls and operator assistance
Independent reproduction success on same inputs and hardware
Incorrect fix attempts, crashes, device loss, timeouts and unresolved cases
metrics.setup: Record acquisition, installation and preparation separately; do not hide total setup burden
metrics.failures: Incorrect final fixes and timeouts are failures. Retain unsuccessful attempts and censored timings; do not average only solved cases or silently drop failures.

decisionRules.inference: Descriptive pilot only. Success requires mechanism/reproduction plus unchanged F64 oracle and application control. Wrong fixes and timeouts fail and remain recorded. No superiority/equivalence test or confirmatory sample authorized.

noveltyTrack.method: For each claim link Doppler implementation/tests, version-pinned competitor code/docs, and scoped verdict. Separate checkout features from installed/published versions and measure integration work where necessary.
candidates: Application approval of exact TargetPlan execution identity
Token inspection with exact-prefix replay and execution fingerprints
Bounded shared LoRA experiment; four fixture tokens and one update is not useful quality improvement
verdicts: novel within explicitly reviewed tool/version set only

allowedConclusions: Distinctive and useful within reviewed scope
Distinctive but no demonstrated debugging advantage
No demonstrated practical advantage within a sufficiently supported comparison
preparerWorkRemaining: Timestamp fresh-context investigator starts; independently score and reproduce patches.

state.freshFetchProof: Preparer-only record; no participant checkout uses stale aliases

handoff.acceptanceEvidence: Frozen packet hashes; repaired and defective learned-model M3 controls; exact-prefix inspection replay; sandbox denial/GPU checks. Trial results not yet available.
handoff.boundaryEffects: none; no runtime, service, GPU or model changes
